主要内容: On December 28, 2016, Blonder Tongue Laboratories, Inc. entered into a Loan and Security Agreement with Sterling National Bank. The agreement provides a $8,500,000 credit facility, including a $5,000,000 asset-based revolving line of credit and a $3,500,000 amortizing term loan. The term loan amortizes at $19,444 per month. Interest rates are based on 30-day LIBOR plus 4.00% and 4.50% margins. The credit facility matures in December 2019. The agreement is secured by the company's assets and guaranteed by Blonder Tongue Far East. Covenants include maintaining a fixed charge coverage ratio of at least 1.1 to 1.0 and a leverage ratio of no more than 2.0 to 1.0. The Loan Agreement also involves a mortgage on the company's headquarters and a subordination agreement. The Santander Agreement was terminated on the same date. The Loan Agreement allows Sterling to pursue its rights under the agreement and applicable law in case of default, including non-payment of principal or interest. The Company's actions under the Loan Agreement may impact its financial obligations and operations in the electronics industry.
